messages:
anna: quick postmortem follow-up: nightly batch spikes + rollout flaps caused noisy CPU pages. want clear owners and short timeline for alert tuning.

mike: agreed. spikes are short (30-90s) around 02:45-03:20 UTC. current 1m eval is too sensitive.

javier: i'll handle dedupe + label correlation so we don't page per-host.

anna: proposed plan:
- use 5m eval window for paging (keep 1m for dashboards)
- record rule for 5m cpu avg, alert on aggregated ASG p99 -> threshold 92%
- dedupe_by: cluster, asg, service_name/job_label fallback
- schedule a silence for nightly batch window via alertmanager calendar
- route initial notices to #infra-alerts; only page #oncall if sustained >10m or error_rate rises

sarah: i will own runbook updates + calendar silence. will add steps to unmute and rollback model bundles.

mike: i'll change routing and add a low-priority pager for transient infra. target PR today, staging deploy tomorrow.

javier: sample recording rule i'll add in PR: 
```yaml
- record: node:cpu:5m_avg
  expr: avg_over_time(node_cpu_seconds_total[5m])
```
and alert: 
```yaml
- alert: AutoscaleGroupHighCPU
  expr: sum(node:cpu:5m_avg{asg=~"redwood-.*"}) by (asg) / count(node_cpu_seconds_total) > 0.92
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page_if_sustained
```
I'll include dedupe_by in infra-alerts schema.

mike: routing snippet i'll add: initial -> infra-alerts; on sustained or correlated error -> page oncall. will include smoke test for 1m spike.

ops-bot: Incident linked: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-02-05-1684|INC-1684> 1:05 UTC pages during rollout.

anna: owners & deadlines:
- javier: dedupe + recording rule + PR -> due 2026-02-11 EOD
- mike: alertmanager routing + low-priority pager -> due 2026-02-10 noon
- sarah: runbook + scheduled silence -> due 2026-02-11 EOD
- anna: verify 48h after canary and update action tracker (checkpoint 2026-02-13)

javier: starting dedupe work, will post PR link and grafana panels.

mike: opening routing PR now, aiming to deploy to staging tonight.

sarah: runbook ticket created (RED-2789) and calendar entry set for 02:40-03:30 UTC.

anna: please confirm in-thread when you start so I can mark items in the tracker. target: reduce pager volume >=45% for this rule. :white_check_mark:
